The Opportunity
This position is a remote opportunity in the Abbott Diabetes Care Division. We are helping people with Diabetes lead healthier, happier lives. As a global leader in diabetes care, Abbott is constantly working to deliver the highest quality products and unwavering support to our customers.

Consistent and accurate glucose monitoring is the foundation of any diabetes management plan, so we’re committed to continuous improvement in the way patients and professionals measure, track and analyze glucose levels.
As a Diabetes Sales Specialist, you are responsible for meeting or exceeding sales quotas/objectives for ADC Products. Collaborate with various channels, Managed Care and Retail and Point of Care representatives.

Establishing strong relationships with a broad base of internal and external health care constituents (e.g., physicians, nurses, pharmacists, CDEs, etc.) acting in a friendly, respectful, adaptive manner and focusing on the needs and interests of others.

Divisional Information
Medical Devices

Our medical devices help more than 10,000 people have healthier hearts, improve quality of life for thousands of people living with chronic pain and movement disorders, and liberate more than 500,000 people with diabetes from routine ﬁngersticks.
CRM
As a global leader in Cardiac Rhythm Technologies, we focus on innovative technologies that can improve the way doctors treat people with heart arrhythmias, or irregular heartbeats.
Diabetes
We’re focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health with life-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology.
Vascular
Abbott Vascular provides innovative, minimally invasive, and cost-effective products for treatment of vascular disease.
Neuromodulation
Our Neuromodulation business includes implantable devices compatible with mobile technology to help people who suffer from chronic pain and movement disorders. These non-opioid therapies allow us to provide interventional pain therapy to patients throughout the pain continuum.

What You’ll Work On
The Digital Health Solutions Sales Executive (DHSE) is accountable for business and revenue growth within the designated region/country i ndependent hunting, prospecting, territory buildout, digital-first consulting, and pipeline creation.

DHSE achieves this by providing end-to-end Digital Health Solutions with intelligent insights to enable health care providers, from laboratories to public hospitals to private integrated delivery systems, to achieve revenue targets by improving operational performance and clinical outcomes of existing and new customers.

Acquire new business within assigned district(s), where there is no existing Diagnostics and / or AlinIQ footprint.
Cold outreach, market mapping, and territory penetration, Self-sourced pipeline creation

Identify new opportunities for growth by focusing on end-to-end health care improvements as primary value driver for in and outside the lab to pull through digital health solution sales and reagent sales.
Be knowledgeable about industry trends, changing market regulations and healthcare policy within defined customer segment. Understand the impact on customers and their key care-abouts.
Lead and execute complex contract negotiations to achieve the sales quota for given customer base. Create strong territory and strategic account plans to lay out strategic approach and share best practices with larger Sales team to help drive a culture of excellence.
Review account activity, anticipate customer needs and improve customer satisfaction.
Accountable for driving market share growth through new business opportunity realization. The role is instrumental in expanding brand reputation and delivery of sales and profitability objectives.
Research target accounts to understand performance KPIs and customer strategies to drive conversations that demonstrate how the application of IT enablers and service solutions in/outside of the lab and across the broader healthcare space can improve performance KPIs and strategies.
Work collaboratively with sales and DHS counterparts to achieve performance targets and exceed customer expectations.
Navigate within a highly matrixed environment using strong communication and interpersonal skills to coordinate appropriate Abbott resources and support necessary.
Ensures that all activities are performed in compliance with quality system requirements.

Bachelor’s Degree or Associate’s degree with 4 years of sales experience; a focus in healthcare/medical, life sciences, IT or medical technology is preferred
4+ years in sales roles

Demonstrated ability to align and integrate diverse business teams and functions to ensure they work together to deliver results.

s.h: We're looking for Business Development Representatives
s.t:
We’re building a new insurance business from the ground up to protect SMEs, and we’re looking for Business Development Representatives to join our team. If you’re a high-energy communicator who loves building relationships and wants to gain experience, qualifications, and career progression at a leading fintech, apply now.
The company
We're here because we believe in SMEs. We believe they deserve better than confusing jargon, slow and outdated customer experiences, and being caught out by hidden conditions and fees. And we believe it's our job to help them navigate risk with confidence.
Since 2012, iwoca has made finance fast, flexible, and fair for over 150,000 businesses. Now, we're doing the same for insurance. We're building a brand new insurance business from the ground up — to protect SMEs in the moments that matter most.
Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed by providing access to better finance and services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team is a small, entrepreneurial group responsible for launching iwoca's new SME insurance business. Here’s how the team work together:
Customer-obsessed: The team challenges itself to build insurance that its customers actually want, rather than what insurers simply want to sell.
Curious & supportive: The team collaborates across disciplines to find creative solutions to complex problems in a safe and supportive environment.
Move fast & have fun: The team is fast-paced and highly autonomous, but makes sure to celebrate wins and have fun along the way.
Ambitious & entrepreneurial: The environment is ideal for people who thrive on taking ownership of their work and are ready to roll up their sleeves and build.

You’ll be the person introducing our new insurance offering to businesses who are tired of the status quo. You’ll help SMEs move away from complicated, slow insurance policies and make them aware of a fairer, more transparent way to protect their business.

Proactively engage with SME business operators by phone ahead of their business insurance renewal date to offer a better alternative.
Master the art of the pitch—navigating gatekeepers, articulating our value proposition, and turning objections into opportunities for our brokers to help them.
Manage your pipeline end-to-end within our HubSpot CRM, ensuring meticulous record-keeping and proactive follow-ups so that no opportunity is missed.
Collaborate closely with our in-house brokers and wider team to turn early customer feedback into insights that refine our product offering and sales strategy.

Previous experience navigating outbound or client-facing interactions within a professional business environment.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build rapport, influence decisions, and handle commercial objections over the phone and email.
A high-energy, resilient, and results-oriented personality that thrives on achieving goals. You have sharp problem-solving instincts and a "can-do" mindset.
Organised and proactive approach to managing your workload.
Ability to adapt and excel in a fast-moving, high-growth atmosphere.
Eagerness to learn - insurance industry experience isn’t necessary - we will provide training to help you succeed.
A desire to secure professional qualifications and drive long-term career progression within a rapidly scaling fintech environment

We expect to pay around £30,000 plus bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.
The culture
At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the professional development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage you to explore new areas of interest to help us innovate and improve our products and services.
The offices

Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.
Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

Flexible working hours.
Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.
A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.
25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.
A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.
Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.
3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.
With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of events, memberships, and learning products, we help individuals and teams grow faster in their careers. We work with some of the world’s most recognisable companies and pride ourselves on being a high-impact learning partner, not just another events business.
We’re ambitious, we move quickly, and we’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, a steep learning curve, and plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

We’re hiring early-career Sales Associates to join our Delegate & Membership sales team , people with energy, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in commercial roles.
This is a junior role by design. You don’t need years of experience, what matters most is how quickly you learn, how well you take feedback, and how comfortable you are being challenged. We’ll teach you how to sell properly: how to prospect, qualify, handle objections, manage a pipeline, and close, all while speaking to senior decision-makers at some of the world’s biggest tech companies.
You’ll sell across our live events, memberships, and learning solutions in markets including London, New York, San Francisco, Las Vegas and beyond. Over time, this role can progress into more senior sales or specialist commercial paths across the business.
This role is not about arriving fully formed, it’s about building and proving confidence, capability, and momentum through doing.
What You'll Be Doing
Sales Upskilling: You’ll build strong foundations in prospecting, qualification, pipeline management, and closing, while learning how to sell confidently to senior B2B stakeholders and work to clear targets and expectations.
Engaging decision-makers: You’ll speak directly with professionals at fast-growing and enterprise tech companies, understand their challenges, and recommend the right events, memberships, and learning solutions.
Owning deals end-to-end: You’ll own your pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week.
Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling.
Collaboration & feedbac k: You’ll work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support.
This Role Is For You If
You’re early in your career and hungry to learn, not entitled to results
You’re comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new
You actively seek feedback and apply it quickly
You take ownership for outcomes, not just effort
You’re resilient, organised, and able to manage pace and pressure
You communicate clearly with customers and with teammates
You enjoy working as part of a team where success is shared
Our Hiring Process
Our hiring process is designed to reflect how we actually work: collaborative, practical, and focused on potential rather than polish.
First interview (values, motivation, and learning mindset)
One-day assessment in our London office (practical exercises, collaboration, and real-world sales scenarios)
Final shortlist: up to 3 candidates selected into an onboarding cohort, starting together and learning side-by-side
This process helps us understand how you think, learn, and show up — not just how well you interview.
